name: Odèn (Spain)
description: Red field charged towards the hoist with a yellow cross with triangular convex arms above a white crescent.
history: The official flag of Odèn is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, red, with the yellow triangulated and convex cross at the end of the first vertical third from the hoist, with the white crescent at the foot of the cross; approved on 7 December 1992 and published in the DOGC on 18 December 1992.
